question: Do legal-state delayed-return rate controls improve full-lifetime adaptation beyond strong complete external methods and simpler shared-base rate rules?
hypothesis: A StreamRate increment must survive module-only/shifted/fixed controls and external baselines; this proposed pilot cannot confirm that rate control substitutes for a different actor or critic target.

selection.rule: Proposed author-default anchors and named mechanism controls. No HPO is performed by this protocol. Resolve exact versions/configurations and seed reservation in a new registered external protocol before execution. Any later method-specific HPO is a separate study with equal declared search resources; freeze selection before independent confirmation.

implementation: Qualify author Stream-AC and Intentional-AC call chains; verify Metatrace scalar/vector/Mixed identity, complete TD derivative, entropy and continuous-policy conventions.
Check prequential order: action uses available state; delayed meta credit is assigned causally; current rate is applied at the declared update event without future rewards.
Keep original numerical failures; any std floor or bound repair is a separately named algorithm and new run population.
mechanism: Separate actor target, critic evaluation, step-size magnitude and delayed-credit use. Positive bounded multipliers cannot generally change zero support or coordinate signs.
Compare StreamRate against module-only, causal shifted-features and functional-fixed controls without altering their shared actor/critic objectives.
Stage Q-base 2x2 target-by-rate diagnostic separately: advantage/elite actor target crossed with fixed/meta rates; do not call this V-critic Stream-AC or original replay GreedyAC.
performance: Score every raw reward over the complete 400148-step lifetime, including transient switch losses and partial final episodes.
Report all external baselines, failures and missing cells. Incomplete strong-baseline coverage blocks complete-method superiority claims.
Use independent confirmation lifetimes and unobserved schedule families; a single shift, active meta writes or exact derivatives cannot establish continual-RL improvement.

registration_requirements: Pin and hash original external code and exact dependency closure; qualify any equation ports separately.
Replace every UNREGISTERED placeholder and method-default label with exact numeric configuration; revalidate and freeze a new protocol.
Verify task reward/action/clocks and bootstrap semantics, no boundary label reaches policy, and all baseline interfaces are supported.
Reserve exclusive job/seed namespace and independent output locations; never mutate or relaunch a frozen existing population.
Predeclare task-specific failure interpretation and minimum-effect margins; the scalar floor here is a provisional composite pilot outcome, not an imputed reward or cross-task calibrated score.
Do not aggregate unnormalized raw rewards across tasks; produce task-stratified statistics and registered within-task margins.

secondary: prechange-anchored recovery on comparable reward scales
A-return early reward versus first A with no reset
per-seed failure type/time and resource cost
analysis_plan.multiplicity: Predeclare contrasts per task; adjustment family and practical margins require registration. Do not pool raw rewards across Pendulum/Reacher.
analysis_plan.confirmation: Independent lifetimes and held-out schedule families after full development/HPO selection; include altered dwell times, gradual drift, cue/memory variants where relevant, and longer horizons.
